name: East Longmeadow (United States)
description: Red field bearing EAST LONGMEADOW and MASSACHUSETTS in white, with the town seal between the dates 1894 and 1994, a centennial flag.
history: East Longmeadow is a town in Hampden County, Massachusetts, incorporated in 1894; the flag carries the dates 1894 and 1994 of the town's centennial.

features.role: words EAST LONGMEADOW and MASSACHUSETTS and the dates 1894 and 1994
